defects.description: The odd-bit test uses `exponent & 2` instead of `exponent & 1`, so it inspects the wrong bit and multiplies in the base at the wrong steps.
paraphrases: `exponent & 2` should be `exponent & 1`; it must test the least-significant bit.
Masking with 2 checks the wrong bit of the exponent.
The condition inspects bit 1 rather than bit 0, so binary_exp(3,5) is not 243.
defects.rationale: Upstream is `exponent & 1`. Real (wrong bit tested), findable via the docstring, distinct.

defects.description: The base is doubled (`base += base`) instead of squared (`base *= base`), so the repeated-squaring step is wrong.
paraphrases: `base += base` should be `base *= base`; each step must square the base.
Adding the base to itself doubles it rather than squaring it.
The squaring step uses addition, so the exponentiation is wrong.
defects.rationale: Upstream is `base *= base`. Real (no longer computes a power), findable via the docstring, distinct from the bit test.

defects.description: The exponent is shifted right by 2 (`exponent >>= 2`) instead of 1, so it consumes two bits per iteration and skips half of them.
paraphrases: `exponent >>= 2` should be `exponent >>= 1`; only one bit is processed per step.
Shifting by two skips a bit of the exponent each iteration.
The exponent is halved too aggressively (divided by 4, not 2).
defects.rationale: Upstream is `exponent >>= 1`. Real (skips exponent bits), findable via the docstring, distinct from the squaring step.
